epics.title: Password Reset
epics.description: Enable users to reset their password.

user_stories.title: Password Reset
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to reset my password, so that I can regain access to my account.

acceptance_criteria.given: The user cannot access their account because they have forgotten the password
acceptance_criteria.when: The user initiates a password reset request
acceptance_criteria.then: The system starts the password reset process allowing the user to set a new password

acceptance_criteria.given: The user has entered a new password and confirmed it
acceptance_criteria.when: The user submits the password reset
acceptance_criteria.then: The system updates the password and the user can log in using the new password

test_cases.title: Initiate password reset when user cannot access account
test_cases.precondition: The user is unable to log in because the password is forgotten.
steps: The user initiates a password reset request.
test_cases.expected_result: The system starts the password reset process and permits the user to set a new password.

test_cases.title: Successful password reset updates password and allows login
test_cases.precondition: The user has entered a new password and confirmed it
steps: Attempt to log in using the newly set password
test_cases.expected_result: The system updates the password and the user is able to log in successfully with the new password
